order: Make recon two-tier. Keep the existing scout for every where-and-what mission — locate, map, enumerate, history — cheap, parallel and high-recall, and add a detective role for the why-and-how cases: root-cause analysis, cross-subsystem tracing, invariant discovery, recon where fact-gathering cannot be separated from reasoning and a confidently wrong report would misdirect the plan. The detective carries the scout's read-only law unchanged; recon is the one unreviewed output in the harness, so the intelligence that steers decisions must get the capable tier. Write the detective charter with hypothesis-first rules, path-and-line evidence chains and graded CONFIRMED, LIKELY and UNCERTAIN verdicts; narrow the scout's description away from all codebase searching and add a rule handing causal cores off as detective cases; add the company-table row, two-tier routing with pipelining, and an escalation rule making a scout UNKNOWN that survives one re-probe a detective case; update the guard's denial hint, the installer's stamped agent set, the documentation and the version.
claims: The new role is added under the same read-only law, the scout hands causal cores off, and the routing, escalation, guard hint, stamped agent set, documentation and version bump are all in place. Syntax checks pass on the installer and both hooks, three of three, and an install-then-uninstall round-trip into a scratch directory stamps the six agent charters and returns the project to a standard setup.
